snippet.title: Opus: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009144/

- “We will find each other, no matter how long it takes.”
An Asian space opera about fate bringing two lovers together, only to tear them apart.
    
    Opus: Echo of Starsong is a narrative adventure game set in a lawless sci-fi universe. Players will play as Jun, an exiled adventurer. And Eda, a girl who can sing mysterious “starsongs”. With the help of Eda’s Starsongs, the duo will explore uncharted asteroids and solve puzzles as they venture out to the heart of space to unravel an ancient myth.
    
    Theme Song - Echo of Starsong
    Performed by: Cikado
    Music by: Triodust
    String Arrangements: The Convolution(Triodust & Chun-Yu Lung), Hoskey
    Strings Performed by: Chun-Yu Lung
